# M13: Units 23–25 (short melodies, both hands, note stacks) and the end of the course

Goal: the whole 25-unit course playable. Spec: SPEC §8.6 (melody-move, hear-melody,
together-or-not, stack-or-not, stack-name), §8.7 (tunes, stacks), §8.9, §8.11 (Path end);
CURRICULUM §8 (T, G, C mixes), §9.2–§9.3, §10 units 23–25, §11, §12.

## Steps
1. **Domain:** the five kinds, prompts and feedback, builder generators (tunes of the same time
   for hear-melody, valid marked notes for melody-move, together/apart pairs, real and not-real
   stacks), u24-l2 `markStaff`, the finale lesson mixing card and material kinds. Property tests
   for units 23–25.
2. **Curriculum data:** units 23–25, concept cards. ids lock.
3. **UI:** `MelodyMove`, `HearChoice` for tunes (grand tunes too), `TogetherOrNot`,
   `StackOrNot`, `StackName` (Letter pad + helper line; grand when `withBass`). Path-end card.
4. **Path/Progress:** units 23–25; Path-end card when every level-1 lesson is done.
5. **E2E** (`e2e/part2-melodies.spec.ts`): every lesson completes; Path-end card appears with a
   seeded "all done" document; sound-off finale has no listening question.
6. **Whole-course loop:** extend the M6 loop test (phone, `test.slow()`) to all 109 level-1
   lessons, 36 level-2/3 lessons and 6 checkpoints, starting from the **v1 fixture** shape so the
   upgrade path is exercised end to end.
7. Screenshots + visual QA. `HANDOFF.md`, `NOTES.md`. `npm run verify` green; "debug again".

## Review step (Opus)
Review prompt from `docs/build/README.md` with M13.

## Acceptance
- The full course (units 1–25, checkpoints a–f) is playable start to finish. `npm run verify` green.
